title: Things pack
description: This small datapack can add a small fun!
body:
# Things pack

A small datapack that adds fun, lightweight extras to your world — starting with a free custom barrel.

## Features

- **Auto-welcome message** — shows an actionbar message confirming the pack has loaded, no setup required.
- **Free Barrel** — get a barrel renamed to `FreeBarrel` with a single command.

## How to get the barrel

Run this command in-game:

```
/function things:free_barrel
```

![barrel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5be40205294bc8f172c7b1a94177b05f996e59c.png)

You'll receive a barrel with a custom name shown in its interface when opened.

## Installation

1. Download the file below.
2. Place it in your world's `datapacks` folder (`saves/<world_name>/datapacks/`).
3. Run `/reload` in-game, or restart your world/server.
4. Confirm it's active with `/datapack list enabled`.

## Compatibility

Built for the modern data pack format (107), compatible with recent 1.21.x snapshots/releases using the `min_format`/`max_format` pack.mcmeta structure.

## Notes

This is a simple, low-overhead datapack — it only runs a couple of commands and doesn't add any recurring tick logic, so it has minimal impact on performance.
